title: X-Ray Hooper
style: Glowing white X-ray skeleton basketball player with subtle blue muscle highlights, dark NBA court at night, arena crowd in the dark background, smooth realistic human biomechanics, cinematic, vertical composition.

shots.name: 01_walkout
shots.action: The skeleton walks out of the dark tunnel onto the court, ball tucked under one arm, spotlight finding him at half court; slow push-in on his glowing skull.

shots.name: 02_pound
shots.action: Low, violent right-hand pound dribbles, the ball snapping off the hardwood, camera at ball height in front of him.

shots.name: 03_tweeners
shots.action: Rapid between-the-legs combo, three in a row, low stance, the ball a blur under him, front three-quarter view.

shots.name: 04_snatch
shots.action: He dribbles hard right with one violent pound dribble, snatches the ball back left in a low crossover, stops dead with a 1-2 step, rises straight up with no forward drift, releases a smooth jump shot at the peak, high arc swish.

shots.name: 05_btb_dunk
shots.action: Behind-the-back dribble into a hard drive down the lane, two steps, two-hand dunk, the rim shaking.

shots.name: 06_spin_fade
shots.action: Spin move at the elbow, fades away over his left shoulder, jumper at the top, swish, he holds the follow-through.

shots.name: 07_stepback
shots.action: A second X-ray skeleton defender with red muscle highlights guards him on the wing; crossover, hard step-back behind the arc, high-arc three, swish.

shots.name: 08_hesi_reverse
shots.action: Hesitation dribble at the top, explodes baseline past the red-highlighted skeleton defender, reverse layup off the glass.

shots.name: 09_eurostep
shots.action: Euro step through the lane, left then right around the defender, soft finger roll over the rim.

shots.name: 10_shamgod
shots.action: Pull-back crossover (Shamgod) at the top of the key, the defender stumbles, pull-up jumper, swish.

shots.name: 11_tweener_three
shots.action: Tweener crossover, side-step to his left, set feet, three-pointer from the corner, net snaps.

shots.name: 12_fastbreak
shots.action: Full-speed fast break down the court, camera tracking alongside, one dribble, takeoff from the dotted line, tomahawk dunk.

shots.name: 13_self_oop
shots.action: Throws the ball off the backboard to himself, catches it in the air and finishes with a windmill dunk.

shots.name: 14_freethrow
shots.action: At the free-throw line: three dribbles, spins the ball in his fingers, deep breath, release, swish; camera behind him.

shots.name: 15_gamewinner
shots.action: Isolation at the top against the red defender, two crossovers, rises over the contest at the buzzer, the shot drops; arena lights flare.

shots.name: 16_walkoff
shots.action: He walks back into the dark tunnel with the ball under his arm, glow fading, the court lights dimming behind him.
